mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have a temperature of 63 degrees with moderate rain reported near Verona Area High School under a Waning Gibbous moon. The overnight low will be 62 degrees with rain predicted.

City residents should be aware of a few updates. Road surface treatments begin August 4 on Lincoln Street, so look for no-parking signs tomorrow. Also, the city provides a 100 dollar rebate for replacing old toilets with high-efficiency models, and you can now request police records online through crashdocs.org.

There is plenty to do, with live music at Bailey's Run happening today. Tomorrow, you can participate in the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree, visit the Dane County Farmers' Market, or get free medical care at the high school. Looking further out, enjoy trivia at Hop Haus on August 4.
In a recent report, on July 23, officers responded to a residence on Lucerne Drive where a 23-year-old man was arrested for disorderly conduct and intimidation of a victim.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. Culver's is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
